notes: KING/ETH pool with a King of the Hill throne game run entirely by the hook. Every buy and sell pays a fee in ETH on the settled ETH delta (exact-input and exact-output): 25% at pool initialization decaying linearly to 2.5% over 30 minutes, split 92% to the throne pool and 8% to the team wallet 0x39E3414e7a43DE41675e9bEC52F7C9F6ae489CB6, both pull-based through claim(). Fees are held as ERC-6909 ETH claims on the PoolManager, so no swap depends on the manager holding ETH. When the 30 minutes end the throne opens: a single buy through the hook-owned KingRouter whose ETH amount (fee included) is at least the throne price makes the buyer king; the price becomes 1.2x what he paid, halves every hour down to a 0.01 ETH floor, and is the floor while the throne is empty. The king earns 2% of the throne pool per hour, credited per second and claimable any time, also after losing the throne. He must keep the KING his takeover bought: a sell through KingRouter, or any swap or permissionless dethrone() call that finds his balance below that amount, empties the throne. A must-take flag in hookData reverts a buy that would not take the throne. Only hookData from KingRouter is trusted to name the buyer; other routers' swaps pay the fee but cannot take the throne. No owner, no parameters, not upgradeable, not pausable; the hook never acts on transfers or liquidity changes. Launch: pool initialized at sqrtPriceX96 for 1e8 KING per ETH (10 ETH market cap), 90% of supply as single-sided KING liquidity below the current tick, 0% to the requester.
